children: Renk Group said it plans to invest more than 20 million euros, or $23.2 million, through 2030 to expand its production capacity in a site located in Rheine, Germany.
The defense company said it also intends to more than triple its output of transmissions at its headquarters in Augsburg to exceed 2,000 units a year by 2030.

The expansion plan is part of the investments the company has committed to as part of the "Made for Germany" initiative, which aims to boost growth and investor confidence in the German economy. Renk said Monday that it plans to invest up to 325 million euros in its home country in digitalization, innovation, and capacity expansion.
Since 2025, the company has been strengthening its facilities and changing its production methods, it said.
